bugs.error_message: Race condition: closing buffer causes content from closed buffer to overwrite active buffer content. Symptoms: after closing tab, reopening shows wrong content even after git discard.
bugs.root_cause: save_current_text_buffer_history() was called with stale active_buffer_index after buffer removal. The function would save closed buffer's content (still in self.text) into wrong buffer slot. Also, self.text was not reset after clearing active_buffer_index, allowing stale content to persist.
bugs.fix: 1. Added bounds check in save_current_text_buffer_history() to prevent saving when old_idx >= buffers.len(). 2. Reset self.text and cached_line_starts immediately after clearing active_buffer_index in close_current_buffer() to prevent stale content from being saved during next activate_buffer_index() call.

bugs.error_message: Data loss when opening special buffers (Settings, Terminal, Help, References, Diagnostics, Fuzzy Picker): unsaved changes in current text buffer are lost without being saved to buffer history.
bugs.root_cause: All open_*_buffer() functions (open_settings_buffer, open_terminal_buffer, open_help_buffer, open_references_buffer, open_diagnostics_buffer, open_pending_references_buffer) and register_open_text_buffer() directly set active_buffer_index without calling save_current_text_buffer_history() first. This causes unsaved changes in the current text buffer to be lost when switching to special buffers.
bugs.fix: Added save_current_text_buffer_history() call at the beginning of: open_diagnostics_buffer(), open_terminal_buffer(), open_help_buffer(), open_references_buffer(), open_pending_references_buffer(), open_settings_buffer(), and register_open_text_buffer(). Note: open_fuzzy_picker_buffer() already had this fix.

bugs.error_message: F12 (FocusTerminal), ToggleTerminal, and ToggleBottomDock open terminal panel and focus it, but don't enter TerminalFocus mode, so text input doesn't work.
bugs.root_cause: When opening terminal panel, the commands set focus_manager to BottomPanel and spawn terminal tab, but never call apply_mode_event(ModeEvent::FocusTerminal) to transition from Normal/Insert/Visual mode into TerminalFocus mode. Without the mode transition, keyboard input is not routed to the terminal.
bugs.fix: Added apply_mode_event(ModeEvent::FocusTerminal) call after opening terminal in all three commands: FocusTerminal (line 218-220), ToggleTerminal (line 78-82), and ToggleBottomDock (line 115-117). This ensures the editor enters TerminalFocus mode when terminal panel opens, enabling text input.

bugs.error_message: Explorer paste conflict prompt (when pasting file with duplicate name) shows command palette to rename, but doesn't accept text input - user cannot type to edit the filename.
bugs.root_cause: ExplorerPasteConflict mode handler (lines 205-223) only matched FilePickerAppendQuery and FilePickerBackspaceQuery commands, but did not match the actual typing commands (InsertChar, InsertText, Backspace) that are generated by keyboard input. Other explorer prompts (ExplorerCreateFile, ExplorerRenameFull, etc.) were handled correctly in the next match arm (lines 224-278) which included all typing commands.
bugs.fix: Added InsertChar, InsertText, and Backspace to the ExplorerPasteConflict pattern match (lines 205-220). Changed the handler to use dispatch_palette_overlay_command() like other explorer prompts, which properly routes typing commands to the palette text buffer.

bugs.error_message: Severe lag when scrolling large files (700+ lines) with Ctrl-U/D. Editor freezes for 100-200ms on each scroll.
bugs.root_cause: Scroll commands (ScrollHalfPageUp, ScrollHalfPageDown, CenterCursorLine, MoveToFirstLine, MoveToLastLine) called submit_parse_for_active_buffer(true) even though they don't modify text content. This triggered full tree-sitter re-parse on every scroll, causing 100-200ms freeze on 700+ line files.
bugs.fix: Removed submit_parse_for_active_buffer(true) call from line 118 in commands_editor.rs. Scroll/navigation commands only need editor_needs_layout = true, not re-parsing. Parse should only be triggered by text-modifying commands.

bugs.error_message: After using * (star search) + n to jump through search results, Ctrl-O (jump back) doesn't work - jump stack is empty.
bugs.root_cause: SearchWordUnderCursor command handler didn't call push_jump() before executing search_word_under_cursor(), so the original cursor position was never saved to the jump back stack. LSP goto-definition correctly pushes jump, but star search didn't.
bugs.fix: Added ctx.app_state.push_jump() at line 186 in navigation.rs, before calling search_word_under_cursor(). This matches the behavior of LSP goto-definition (commands_lsp.rs:667) and allows Ctrl-O to return to the position before star search.

bugs.error_message: Embedded terminal colors look washed out and differ from native terminal applications
bugs.root_cause: ANSI RGB/xterm colors were uploaded as sRGB values even though the wgpu render target expects linear color input, combined SGR sequences emitted only the first style event, bold SGR state was parsed but not used for glyph shaping, and PTY output was post-processed by regex highlighting that overwrote application-provided ANSI colors.
bugs.fix: Convert ANSI colors through the shared sRGB-to-linear path, emit all style events from multi-parameter SGR sequences, shape bold terminal cells with bold font weight, and stop applying regex foreground overrides to interactive PTY grids.

Terminal focus: terminal_input_payload returns None for Esc, so Esc fell through to the terminal resolver -> FocusBack -> release_focus_mode_to_editor() ExitFocus, leaving terminal focus. Added tests zen_mode_active_forwards_escape_to_terminal_pty and non_zen_terminal_escape_does_not_forward_raw_pty.

bugs.error_message: Can't scroll up/down in the right-sidebar opencode chat (PanelTabId::Terminal). User asked to bind Ctrl+U/Ctrl+D to scroll the chat there.
bugs.root_cause: focused_terminal_grid_mut() only handled CenterEditor and BottomPanel, not RightSidebar, so TerminalScrollUp/Down returned None for the right opencode terminal (mark_focused_terminal_layout_dirty also lacked the RightSidebar branch). Additionally, in TerminalFocus the input handler forwards Ctrl+U/D as raw control bytes to the PTY, so they never reached a scroll command.

Bottom-panel shell keeps raw ^U/^D. Tests: right_sidebar_terminal_ctrl_u_d_scroll_half_page, bottom_terminal_ctrl_u_d_still_forward_raw_to_pty.

bugs.error_message: Vietnamese tone marks dropped when rendering opencode output in the terminal. Base vowels with circumflex (ô ê â) showed, but tone marks were lost: 'bạn'->'ban', 'cụ thể'->'cu thê', 'kiểu'->'kiêu'. User suspected line-height clipping.
bugs.root_cause: NOT a line-height issue (panel_line_height 22 vs panel_font_size 14 is generous). The terminal grid stores one Unicode scalar per cell: print_char_at_cursor always wrote the char and advanced the cursor, with no handling for zero-width combining marks. The ANSI parser emits each codepoint as a separate PrintChar with no normalization. So a combining tone mark (e.g. precomposed 'ô' U+00F4 followed by combining dot-below U+0323) landed in its own cell, advancing the cursor; the lone mark shaped in isolation rendered clipped/invisible and the base lost its tone.
bugs.fix: Added unicode-normalization dep. In print_char_at_cursor, detect combining marks via unicode_normalization::char::is_combining_mark; instead of consuming a cell, fold the mark into the previous cell's base char by NFC-normalizing base+mark (grapheme.nfc()). NFC reorders marks canonically first, so it composes even when the stream sends marks out of canonical order (pairwise char::compose alone misses 'ô'+U+0323 -> 'ộ' because ộ decomposes to ọ+circumflex). Only adopt the result if it collapses to a single scalar; otherwise keep base and drop mark to avoid misaligning the fixed-width grid. Cursor not advanced (zero-width). Tests: combining_marks_fold_into_base_cell, stacked_combining_marks_compose_incrementally, precomposed_vietnamese_passes_through, leading_combining_mark_is_dropped_not_misaligned.

bugs.error_message: External file changes (create/delete/rename + content edits) do not update the IDE: open file, edit it elsewhere, IDE does not refresh at all
bugs.root_cause: The notify file-watch worker emitted FileSystemEvents via emit_message (no wake) and dispatch.rs never passed event_proxy into run_file_watch_request. With ControlFlow::Wait the winit loop stayed asleep, so FileSystemEvents sat unconsumed in the mpsc channel until an unrelated event (keypress/mouse/terminal/1s poll tick) woke it. The whole notify path (workspace rescan, file-picker refresh, conflict detection, rename/delete handling) was effectively dead; only the 1s mtime poll over OPEN buffers worked, so tree-level changes never appeared.
bugs.fix: Passed event_proxy into run_file_watch_request and switched the FileSystemEvents emit to emit_message_and_wake (#1). Also: auto-restart watcher with backoff on failure (#4); non-recursive watch for files opened outside workspace root with dedup set (#5, added recursive flag to StartFileWatch payload); poll mtime compare > -> != to catch git checkout restoring older mtime (#2); self-save ignore now content-based via active_disk_content_matches_memory so genuine external edits within the 2s window still reload (#3); reduced safety-net poll 1s -> 3s (#6); removed debug eprintln noise (#7).
